en-US.author: Dave Koons
en-US.description: Convert bank and credit card statement PDFs to Excel, CSV, JSON or OFX on your own computer. Nothing is uploaded.
en-US.longDescription:
LedgerSprout turns bank and credit card statement PDFs into clean spreadsheet data, entirely on your own machine: no upload, no account, no cloud.
Statement layouts are recognised automatically, every row can be reviewed before export, and scanned statements are read with local OCR. Exports to CSV, XLSX, JSON and OFX/QFX. The free Community Edition lets you try it on your own statements. Paid licenses: Individual, $129 one-time; Pro, $349 per year. Licenses are sold through Lemon Squeezy's hosted checkout, which processes the payment; LedgerSprout itself never handles payment details, and statements never leave your computer.
en-US.name: LedgerSprout
